description: A multi-valued slot returns the full resolved set of contained, non-superseded values rather than a single winner. DESIGN-INTENT: no seed attribute declares multi-valued cardinality, so the input declares the slot multi-valued explicitly to show the resolution shape.

input.cardinality_note: core-v1.json declares no 'tags' slot and no multi-valued cardinality; this slot is a design-intent illustration of multi-valued resolution. FieldDef carries cardinality (op-fact-schema-model) but the seed does not populate it.

expected.deciding_rule: multi-valued: union of contained, non-superseded members

superseded.reason: member valid interval [2026-01-01, 2026-03-01) does not contain 2026-06-11

expected.note: A single-valued slot would apply the precedence chain to pick one winner; a multi-valued slot returns every member whose interval contains the instant and is not superseded.
